doc.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Not listening to his own records
summary: He leaves mistakes on records and rarely listens to his own recordings.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, man. I try to do something there and they come and say let’s blip this out. And I’m the kind of guy that if I make a mistake, leave it on the record. That’s me. Leave it there.
Do you listen to your own music much?

No. No. No. Because I always figure the next one I can do better. When I hear something I’ve done I say damn, wow, I did that? I didn’t realize that. All right. Damn. I didn’t remember I could play that.
